filingText: BrightDesk Inc. files this registration statement on Form S-8. This registration statement registers 500,000 shares of common stock, par value $0.001, under the BrightDesk Inc. 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. PART I INFORMATION REQUIRED IN THE SECTION 10(a) PROSPECTUS. PART II INFORMATION REQUIRED IN THE REGISTRATION STATEMENT. Proposed Maximum Aggregate Offering Price: $4,200,000. Amount of Registration Fee: $620. The plan provides equity awards to employees and directors. SIGNATURES.
